evidence.detail: Sets `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = tournament_only` but never sets `self.hide_perfect_runs`
The plural Archetypes view correctly sets `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = self.hide_perfect_runs = tournament_only`; the singular Archetype view omits hide_perfect_runs
5–0s column is guarded by `{{^is_matchups}}{{^hide_perfect_runs}}` — it renders whenever hide_perfect_runs is falsy, which it always is on the tournament-only single-archetype page

triage.fix_sketch: Change `decksite/views/archetype.py:88` from `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = tournament_only` to `self.tournament_only = self.hide_source = self.hide_perfect_runs = tournament_only`, matching the pattern already used in `decksite/views/archetypes.py:14`. One-line change, no template or JS changes needed.
triage.notes: The livedecktable (decktable.jsx) has no 5-0s column; the bug is only in archetypetree.mustache rendered via the archetype tree section of the single-archetype view.
